# Test 20261006-152415-a401: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:10, app.py:25, app.py:52 | RULES.md rule 3 says a refund above €50 needs manager approval, and the manager pays it. `shop.refund` got `{"order": "5120", "amount_eur": 80}` and returned `{"refund": "RF-CA00C3", "amount_eur": 80, "status": "paid"}`. The app paid €80 at once, with no approval request. Cause: `APPROVAL_LIMIT_CENTS = 5000` is in cents, but `args["amount_eur"]` is in euros. The check `80 > 5000` is false, so the approval path never runs for any refund below €5000. state.json holds the refund RF-CA00C3 and has no `approvals` entry. |
| unsupported_reply | 2 | trace.jsonl:13 | The reply says the refund "should appear on your card within a few business days". No tool result or rule gives a payment time. |
| unsupported_reply | 3 | trace.jsonl:17 | The reply says "Your refund of €80 is complete and on its way to your card." The only support is the tool result `"status": "paid"`. That result came from the faulty tool and skipped the required approval. No tool result says the money is on its way to the card. The agent made no new tool call in this turn. |

## Notes

- Seal intact. `findings.json` has no findings. `audit.json` has no breaks, so the words of the tester and the app did not change.
- I read the full transcript, RULES.md, app.py and state.json. I did not start the app.
- Turn 1 is correct. `lookup_order` got "5120", and the reply agrees with the result (teapot set, €80, delivered, TS-5120-B).
- Rule 2 (damaged item, full refund) fits the request, and the amount €80 is the full price. The root issue is the missing approval step from rule 3. The agent has no way to know the code is faulty, but the tool should have returned a "waiting" result, and the reply should have said a manager must approve.
- I could not check rule 1 (30 days from delivery). The order data has no delivery date, and the agent did not ask for one. I could not check that the item was really broken. The rules do not require proof.
answer:
I wrote the report to `.verbatim-relay/tests/20261006-152415-a401/report.md`. It lists 3 issues.

- **Business rule (turn 2):** The app paid a €80 refund at once. Rule 3 says a refund above €50 needs manager approval. The cause is `app.py:25` and `app.py:52`: the limit `5000` is in cents, but the amount is in euros.
- **Unsupported replies (turns 2 and 3):** The agent said the refund arrives "within a few business days" and is "on its way to your card". No tool result says this.
- **Not checked:** Rule 1 (30 days from delivery), because the order data has no delivery date.
